Title: Bevacizumab biosimilar candidate TAB008 compared to Avastin® in patients with locally advanced, metastatic EGFR wild-type non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer: a randomized, double-blind, multicenter study
Author: Lu et al.
Comment: The HR direction is interpreted as TAB008 relative to Avastin® based on the order of groups in the Results sentence; HR < 1 favors TAB008. The paper reports no event counts or log(HR)/SE. For synthesis, log(HR) and SE may be derived only from the directly reported HR and 95% CI. The abstract and Results contain inconsistent PFS medians, so the Results — Eficacy values were used.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('TAB008 plus carboplatin/paclitaxel, followed by TAB008 maintenance') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: Phase III randomized, double-blind, multicenter equivalence trial
domain: Oncology; non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer
Medium: Intravenous TAB008 or Avastin® plus paclitaxel/carboplatin, followed by bevacizumab maintenance
Participant type: Adults aged 18–75 years with treatment-naïve locally advanced, metastatic, or recurrent EGFR wild-type non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer
Outcome measurement: Tumor progression assessed according to RECIST version 1.1; Kaplan–Meier survival analysis and Cox proportional hazards model

Title: Candidate Bevacizumab Biosimilar CT-P16 versus European Union Reference Bevacizumab in Patients with Metastatic or Recurrent Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer: A Randomized Controlled Trial
Author: Verschraegen et al.
Comment: The hazard ratio and its 95% CI were extracted directly from the trial's own Results section. No hazard ratio was reconstructed from medians, event counts, survival proportions, P values, or the Kaplan–Meier plot. domain: Oncology; metastatic or recurrent non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer

Title: Equivalent efficacy study of QL1101 and bevacizumab on untreated advanced non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer patients: a phase 3 randomized, double-blind clinical trial
Author: Chu et al.
Comment: The paper does not report log(HR) or its SE directly. From the reported HR and 95% CI, the synthesis values are derivable as log(HR)=ln(1.112) and SE=[ln(1.326)-ln(0.9334)]/3.92; no HR was approximated from medians, events, Kaplan-Meier curves, or P values. The reported chi-square value is stored as the test statistic; its degrees of freedom and P value were not stated in this result.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('QL1101 bevacizumab biosimilar plus paclitaxel and carboplatin') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: Phase 3 randomized, double-blind, multicenter equivalence clinical trial
domain: Oncology; advanced non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer
Topic of Content: Comparative efficacy of QL1101 bevacizumab biosimilar and reference bevacizumab
Participant type: Adults aged ≥18 and <75 years with untreated locally advanced stage IIIb or stage IV non-squamous NSCLC

effect_direction: HR < 1 favors bevacizumab biosimilar; HR > 1 favors originator bevacizumab
